name: grenke
verdict: grenke AG is an SDAX-listed German leasing company; the founding Grenke family's holding company owns 40.84%. Nothing found.
note: Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): the shareholders above 5% in the 2024 annual report are the family holding and two German fund managers (ACATIS, Universal Investment); no state in the chain and no human-rights finding found. grenke also gives its name to the team's junior squad, grenke - Auto Eder.
